steps.text_en: Start Look at the practice station on the table. Look: The module on the table, the slot with a cut corner, the blue latch, the screw at the back, the cable with its plug. Correct when: You know this is practice, not an experiment task. You can try again after a mistake.

Start Learn two buttons: Grip (middle finger) and Trigger (index finger). Look: Grip: the module, the latch, the turntable. Trigger: panel buttons, the screw head, the plug head. Correct when: A short label above the part tells you its state. Follow it.
Reference Select another format tab. Look: Tabs: Manual, Steps, Illustrated, Video. Correct when: Same content, a different look. Pick the one that is easiest for you.
Reference Select − to minimize the panel. Look: The panel becomes a small “Open Reference” bar. Correct when: Selecting the bar brings the panel back.
Reference Move it: point at the handle below, hold Trigger and move. Look: The panel follows your hand. Correct when: Release Trigger and it stays there. Moving it is optional.
Reference Select × to close the panel. Look: The panel goes away. Correct when: “Reference” opens it again at any time.

Examine and Inspect Point at the training module and select “Examine”. Look: Information: the cut corner must match the slot; a latch holds it. Correct when: “Examine” shows information only; it does not fix anything.
Examine and Inspect Select “Inspect” now. Look: The module is not in yet and the screw is loose. Correct when: It shows “Practice result: not ready.” This is what an unfinished job looks like.

Module Press the module straight down into the slot. Look: Hold with Grip and match the cut corners. No half-turn or wrong-way attempt is required. Correct when: The module is fully seated and stays when Grip is released. Close the latch next.

Latch Press Grip once on the blue latch to close it. Look: The module must already be fully seated. The latch closes; do not remove the module again. Correct when: Placed is not the same as secured. With the latch closed, it is secured now.

Turntable Grip the handle on the front edge, or a front corner with a blue bar. Look: Move your hand in an arc around the centre; the station turns with it. You may let go and grab again. Correct when: The label says “Turned 120° of 120°” and the back screw faces you.

Screw Tighten in: pinch the screw head with Trigger, twist clockwise. Look: Look straight at the head. The screw turns and moves in, little by little. Correct when: The label counts up, like “Tightening: 50% in”.
Screw If your wrist cannot twist further, let go and grab it again. Look: The screw stays where it is; it does not go back. Correct when: You carry on from there; your progress is kept.

Screw Keep turning until the label says “Tight: let go to continue”. Look: The screw head is down against the surface and will not turn further. Correct when: The head is down against the surface and cannot turn further in. Release Trigger next.
Screw Release Trigger. Look: The screw is already tight before release. Correct when: The screw stays tight and the panel advances to plugging in.
Cable Pinch the plug head with Trigger (not the wire). Look: Push it straight into the open socket. The other end stays attached. Correct when: The plug is fully in and stays when you let go.

Inspect Select “Inspect” again. Look: Now the module is in, the latch is closed and the screw is tight. Correct when: It shows “Practice result: ready.” This is the result when everything is in and secured.
Cable Pull the plug head straight out. Look: Hold the plug head with Trigger, never the wire. Correct when: The socket is empty. When you let go, the plug returns to its resting place.

Screw Loosen out: twist the screw head counter-clockwise. Look: The screw turns and moves out, little by little; the label shows “Loosening: 40% in”. Correct when: The screw rises until the label says “Fully loose: let go to continue”.
Screw Release Trigger. Look: The screw is already fully loose before release. Correct when: The panel advances to opening the latch.
Latch Open the latch: reach to it and press Grip once. Look: While the latch is closed, the module cannot come out. Correct when: The latch moves to its open position.
Finish Grip the module and lift it out of the slot. Look: The module is out of the slot. Correct when: You see “Practice Complete”. The real tasks use these same moves.

images.caption_en: The practice station A label above the part shows its state. Follow the panel step by step.
Using the Reference Tabs: format · −: minimize · bar: reopen · handle: move · ×: close
Examine and Inspect “Examine” fixes nothing. “Inspect” now shows a ‘not ready’ example.
Insert the module Once correctly seated, close the latch. No wrong-way attempt is required.
The latch Closed holds it in. Open it before pulling the module out.
Turn the station Hold the handle or a front corner and move your hand in an arc.
Which way to twist Tighten in: clockwise. Loosen out: counter-clockwise.
The screw moves in and out Tighten in: the head goes down. Loosen out: it comes up.
Plug in and unplug Always hold the plug head; never pull the wire.
Inspect results Not ready: something is missing. Ready: all in and secured.
